systemic_findings: Token-only figure ranking overweights generic/shared words and first names.
Source path theme/subtheme/series context is strong evidence and must participate in candidate ranking or gating.
Series-qualified assets should reject candidates from incompatible series/year/theme contexts.
Game-only characters need an explicit non-physical routing path instead of remaining in the physical catalog queue.
Generic expression/design labels should remain unresolved unless exact visual/component evidence exists.
Variant-sensitive characters require release/outfit/year disambiguation before component promotion.
Typos/source-local labels should be preserved and audited rather than normalized into an unsupported identity.
